'''Nyzes''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonel of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Colonel Nyzes appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission "In the Halls of Elysium" on Alderaan only if the player takes the dark side option to ignore [[Elana Thul]]'s call for help and leave her to die. In that case, Nyzes will meet the player at the spaceport and inform [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] about Elana's death.
